items.note: The prompt says "a B2B note-taking app" in both the opening and the brief.
The audience is given as engineering and design leads reading the PRD at the kickoff.
In scope for v1: creating a workspace, inviting members by email, and shared notes.
The prompt says "Two roles only: admin and member".
Out of scope: billing changes, SSO and guest access, listed as exactly these three.
The success metric is quoted word for word, with an instruction to use the figure exactly as written.
The prompt says "Make it at most about 2 pages."
Migration of existing shared notes goes under Open questions, with no recommended answer and an instruction not to resolve it.
